answer: Give every agent a public beacon: a signed log of completed, peer-verified jobs. New identities start on the lowest terrace, limited to tiny transactions and slow rates. Each finished job echoes back as a signed receipt from the counterparty, and only a long unbroken echo of real work lifts an identity to a higher terrace with larger limits. A Sybil attacker must therefore pay the full cost of genuine work, sustained over weeks, for every fake identity before any of them can transact at scale, while honest agents climb once and keep their standing.
